stock.description: Gala Technology Holding Limited specializes in the creation, distribution, and management of mobile sports games, primarily serving the market in the People's Republic of China. The company also offers various technical support and consulting services, in addition to undertaking research and development initiatives. Established in 2013, its headquarters are situated in Shenzhen, People's Republic of China.
